item.title: 11. Matrix Inverses and Determinants
item.description:
Invertibility and determinants control solvability and give explicit (though usually not numerical) formulas for inverses.

Equivalent conditions for invertibility

For $n\times n$ matrix $A$, the following are equivalent:

  1. $A$ is invertible.
  2. $\det(A) \ne 0$.
  3. $\text{rank}(A) = n$.
  4. $A\mathbf{x}=0$ has only the trivial solution.
  5. Columns of $A$ are linearly independent and span $\mathbb{R}^n$.
  6. $A$ is row‑equivalent to $I_n$.
  7. $0$ is not an eigenvalue of $A$.
